transcript:
[turn 1] [user] I'd like to find a place to eat.
[turn 2] [assistant] Where should I look? What kind of food are you in the mood for? You can say things like Mexican, Italian or any other kind of food.
[turn 3] [user] Lobster sounds great. Please search in San Mateo.
[turn 4] [assistant] I have found 9 restaurants. Andes Cafe San Mateo is a great restaurant in San Mateo.
[turn 5] [user] What's their phone number?
[turn 6] [assistant] Their number is 650-581-1305.
[turn 7] [user] Any other suggestions?
[turn 8] [assistant] Fuji Sukiyaki is another great choice in San Mateo.
[turn 9] [user] Do they have live music?
[turn 10] [assistant] They do not.
[turn 11] [user] Any other suggestions?
[turn 12] [assistant] Golden Wok would be a great choice in San Mateo.
[turn 13] [user] That would work great. I would like to make a reservation there at evening 5:30 on March 14th.
[turn 14] [assistant] Please confirm the following: You want to eat at Golden Wok in San Mateo on March 14th starting at 5:30 pm. The reservation would be for 2 people.
[turn 15] [user] Yes, that would be great. Do they serve liquor or have live music?
[turn 16] [assistant] Your reservation was successful. They do not play live music or serve alcohol.
[turn 17] [user] Thanks so much!
[turn 18] [assistant] Is there anything else today?
[turn 19] [user] Nope, that'll be all. Thanks!
[turn 20] [assistant] Have a great day!
